title.zh: 新加坡民航局（可持续航空燃料税）命令 2026
title.en: Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (Sustainable Aviation Fuel Levy) Order 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 17 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 3 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (Sustainable Aviation Fuel Levy) Order 2026 and comes into operation on 1 October 2026.

2.—(1) Any term in this Order that is defined in the First Schedule has the meaning given to that term in that Schedule.
(2) For the purposes of this Order, a flight of an aircraft begins when it starts push back from its stand at an airport.
(3) Where any act is required or allowed to be done on a certain day under this Order and that day happens to be a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday (called an excluded day), the act may be considered as done in due time if it is done on the next day, not being an excluded day.

heading.en: SAF levy payable for chargeable flight

text.en:
3. For the purposes of section 87B(1) of the Act, an SAF levy is payable in respect of —
(a)all chargeable passengers on a Type 1 chargeable flight; and
(b)every Type 2 chargeable flight.

heading.en: Who is required to pay SAF levy

text.en: 4. For the purposes of section 87B(2)(a) of the Act, the SAF levy for a chargeable flight is payable by the aircraft operator of that flight.
5. For the purposes of section 87B(2)(b) of the Act, the SAF levy payable is the amount (in Singapore dollar) calculated in accordance with paragraph 1 of the Second Schedule.

7.—(1) Where any amount of SAF levy which an aircraft operator is liable to pay under paragraph 5 remains unpaid after the time by which it is due under paragraph 6, the aircraft operator is liable to pay the Authority interest on that amount or any part of it that remains outstanding (Z).
(2) Interest under this paragraph accrues daily at the rate of 4.5%‑point above the 3‑month compounded SORA for the period —
(a)starting on the day Z is in arrears; and
(b)ending on the day that Z is paid in full to the Authority or the SAF levy collection agent.

chapter.en: PART 3 COLLECTION OF SUSTAINABLE AVIATION FUEL LEVY

text.en: 8. For the purposes of section 87B(3)(f) of the Act, the Singapore Sustainable Aviation Fuel Company Ltd. (UEN 202534055E) is designated to collect, on behalf of the Authority, the SAF levy and interest payable in respect of a chargeable flight.

chapter.en: PART 3 COLLECTION OF SUSTAINABLE AVIATION FUEL LEVY

heading.en: Returns, etc., on collection of SAF levy to Authority

text.en:
9.—(1) For the purposes of section 87B(3)(g) of the Act, the SAF levy collection agent must, after the end of every accounting period, give to the Authority, within a period determined by the Authority, a return stating the information mentioned in Part 1 of the Third Schedule relating to that accounting period.
(2) In addition, the SAF levy collection agent must, within a period of 60 days (or any longer period allowed by the Authority in a particular case) after the end of every quarter, give to the Authority a report stating the information mentioned in Part 2 of the Third Schedule relating to that quarter.
(3) On request by the Authority, the SAF levy collection agent must also give to the Authority, within a period specified by the Authority in the request, the following:
(a)a return stating —
(i)the total amount of the SAF levy to be collected by the SAF levy collection agent for each accounting period that is in arrears for more than 30 days; and
(ii)the name of the persons from whom the SAF levy is due and remains unpaid;
(b)all information contained in the returns mentioned in paragraph 12 and received by the SAF levy collection agent.
(4) The SAF levy collection agent must —
(a)at least once a year, conduct or cause to be conducted an independent audit of its accounts to ascertain its compliance with this Order in relation to its collection of the SAF levy and interest;
(b)keep a written record of the findings of each independent audit conducted under sub‑paragraph (a) and any actions taken by the SAF levy collection agent to address those findings, and give a copy of that record to the Authority on demand; and
(c)no later than 180 days after the end of its financial year, give to the Authority an assurance of the reliability of the contents of —
(i)the returns mentioned in sub‑paragraph (1) or (3)(a) given to the Authority during that financial year; and
(ii)the report mentioned in sub‑paragraph (2) given to the Authority during that financial year,
whether in the form of an audit report or otherwise, being an assurance that is acceptable to the Authority.
(5) The SAF levy collection agent must take, so far as is reasonably practicable, all measures as are necessary to ensure that the information in every return it gives under sub‑paragraph (1) or (3), or every report it gives under sub‑paragraph (2), is correct at the time the return or report is completed and given to the Authority.
(6) Every return the SAF levy collection agent (Y) gives under sub‑paragraph (1) or (3), and every report Y gives under sub‑paragraph (2), must be accompanied by a declaration by or on behalf of Y that Y has taken, so far as is reasonably practicable, all measures as are necessary to ensure that the information in the return or report (as the case may be), is correct at the time the return or report is completed and given to the Authority.
(7) For the purposes of sub‑paragraphs (5) and (6), the SAF levy collection agent is not to be regarded as having taken, so far as is reasonably practicable, all measures as are necessary to ensure that the information in a return or report under this paragraph is correct unless the SAF levy collection agent has taken into account all relevant information supplied by aircraft operators and any other person who receives payments of the SAF levy in preparing the return or report.
(8) In sub-paragraph (2), “quarter” means a period of 3 months ending on 31 March, 30 June, 30 September or 31 December of a calendar year.

chapter.en: PART 3 COLLECTION OF SUSTAINABLE AVIATION FUEL LEVY

heading.en: Payment of SAF levy collections to Authority

text.en:
10.—(1) The SAF levy collection agent must, within a period of 30 days after collecting any SAF levy or interest from any aircraft operator liable to pay the SAF levy or interest, pay to the Authority the amount of the SAF levy or interest collected.
(2) Where any amount of SAF levy or interest that the SAF levy collection agent is liable under sub‑paragraph (1) to pay to the Authority, is not paid to the Authority within the period mentioned in that sub‑paragraph, the SAF levy collection agent is liable to pay to the Authority interest on that amount or any part of it that remains outstanding (Z).
(3) Interest under this paragraph accrues daily at the rate of 4.5%‑point above the 3‑month compounded SORA for the period —
(a)starting on the day Z is in arrears; and
(b)ending on the day that Z is paid in full to the Authority.

chapter.en: PART 3 COLLECTION OF SUSTAINABLE AVIATION FUEL LEVY

heading.en: Penalty in relation to SAF levy collections

text.en:
11.—(1) If it appears to the Authority that —
(a)the SAF levy collection agent —
(i)has failed to collect any amount of SAF levy or interest, the collection of which the SAF levy collection agent is or was responsible for; or
(ii)has failed to pay to the Authority within the period mentioned in paragraph 10(1) any amount of SAF levy or interest collected by it; and
(b)no satisfactory explanation is provided (within a period specified by the Authority) to the Authority with regard to the failure,
the Authority may impose on the SAF levy collection agent a penalty equal to that amount.
(2) To avoid doubt, this paragraph does not affect any liability arising under paragraph 10(2).

heading.en: Returns and record-keeping by aircraft operator liable to pay SAF levy

text.en:
12.—(1) Every aircraft operator (X) liable under paragraph 4 to pay SAF levy must —
(a)give, or cause to be given, to the SAF levy collection agent (Y) a return containing the information set out in Part 3 of the Third Schedule relating to the period specified by Y (called relevant period in Part 3 of the Third Schedule) for the use, by Y, solely to verify and reconcile the SAF levy paid by X to Y; and
(b)keep and retain records, where the records are relevant to the preparation of the return mentioned in sub‑paragraph (a), for a period of 5 years after the record is made.
(2) The information required by sub‑paragraph (1)(a) must be given to Y within such period, and at such regular intervals, as may be specified by Y with the approval of the Authority.
(3) Y may, with the approval of the Authority, require X to give to Y, within such period specified by Y, any information in the possession of X or which X has access to, that Y considers necessary to verify the SAF levy paid by X.
(4) An aircraft operator who, without reasonable excuse, fails to comply with sub‑paragraph (1)(a) or (b), (2) or (3) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $2,000.

heading.en: Passing SAF levy to other persons

text.en:
13.—(1) This paragraph applies if an aircraft operator (X) liable under paragraph 4 to pay SAF levy passed on or intends to pass on that SAF levy or any part of that SAF levy to one or more of the following persons:
(a)a purchaser of an air passenger ticket from X for the carriage of a passenger on a flight;
(b)a person who charters or otherwise procures a flight from X.
(2) X must take all measures as are necessary, so far as is reasonably practicable, to ensure that the amount passed on or intended to be passed on to a person mentioned in sub‑paragraph (1)(a) or (b) is specified in —
(a)if the person is a person mentioned in sub‑paragraph (1)(a) — the air passenger ticket issued to the person; and
(b)if the person is a person mentioned in sub‑paragraph (1)(b) —
(i)any contract between X and the person; and
(ii)any other document issued by X to the person.
(3) An aircraft operator who fails to comply with sub‑paragraph (2) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $2,000.

chapter.en: PART 5 ALLOCATION OF SUSTAINABLE AVIATION FUEL ENVIRONMENTAL ATTRIBUTES

text.en: 14. For the purposes of section 7(1)(gb)(ii) of the Act, a person who does not pay SAF levies may be allocated SAF environmental attributes if they pay an amount determined by the Authority or SAF Procuring Entity as consideration for them.
